title: VALOR HUB -  - FREE KEY -Auto play...
features:
HUSS VALLEY


Auto
- Auto play: plays the rounds for you.
   As a runner: picks the lane with the fewest chasers, dodges dives, grabs gems and revives teammates.
   As a chaser: chases and catches.
   Also answers "Hero or Chicken?", picks the hero when you lead, votes your map and comes back from AFK.
- Live status: round and timer, your role, clean escapes, what it's doing, session counts.
Runner
- Auto cross: runs you to the other safe side, swerving around chasers, dashing out of dives and grabbing gems on the way.
- Auto dodge: when you play yourself, it presses dash when a chaser dives at you.
- Auto revive: gets downed teammates next to you back up.
- Chaser alert: red banner with the nearest chaser's distance, plus "BEHIND YOU".
- Speed edge (risky, off by default): extra speed (+3% to +100%) while you cross, only when a chaser is close or for the whole crossing.
- Safe speed limit (on by default): keeps the speed edge at or below what the game itself allows (runner 40, chaser 37). Turn it off to go faster at your own risk.
Chaser
- Auto catch: dives or swings when a runner is in reach in front of you.
- Auto chase: runs you at the nearest runner, aiming where they're going.
Visuals
- Role ESP through walls: red chaser, green runner, blue safe, grey caught. Bots included, with names and distance.
Rewards (claims by itself)
- Daily quests, event-knife quests, Valley Journey tiers, free wheel spins and the free reward.
- A code box, and your coins and gems.
Server
- Staff alert, auto-stop on a fair-play warning, panic key (End).
- Anti-AFK, AFK saver, Discord report.
- Auto rejoin after a disconnect (never after a kick), server hop.
Works on phones. This game bans speed hacks (3 kicks = 7-day ban). Use the speed edge with the limit off only on an alt.
